packages.vo: Everyone calling Elbaph filler missed what Oda actually set up. The giants' shame is not new, it is the oldest wound in this series. Dorry and Brogy fought a hundred years over a lie about honor. Elbaph pays that off by showing where the lie began. The arc is not slow, it is explaining a grudge you watched two decades ago. New fans see a new island, but old fans see a debt getting paid. Is Elbaph the best setup arc in One Piece, or just fan service for veterans? Leave your take.
